selected_contract: All 77 exact original IT f75v.43-49 groups are retained in order, with no dropped group or contextual/null output.
Every complete group has one fixed normalized source-letter value; different groups may share that value. Physical gaps emit no normalized letters; SPACE is not a group output.

Use unchanged 70 ALIM553 projections inherited from GDT1409. Test every complete 77-letter window, including artificial projection joins, in forward and complete reversed orientation. No within-message orientation switching.
necessary_condition: For every pair of positions carrying the same exact native whole group, the aligned source letters must agree. No converse implication is permitted. This gives existence of a local homophonic lookup table for a surviving window, not a paid or productive writer.

decision_value.no_window: Excludes only the nominated complete passage plus fixed source projections plus exact one-letter context-independent whole-group channel, in the two declared orientations.
decision_value.window_exists: Necessary local capacity only; no source identification, full writing mechanism, meaningful reading or justified assignment of native word meanings.

claim_limits: The 70 nested projections concern one edition, not independent confirmations.
No general Latin, De balneis, homophonic-channel or whole-group-code exclusion.
Working physical group boundaries, exact source edition and normalization, literal contiguity, constant mapping and absence of errors remain assumptions.
No source change, null output, multiletter expansion, contextual key, dropped groups or boundary repair follows automatically.
Earlier GDT967/987 failures, GDT1409 fixed unit-expansion exclusion and prior control failures remain unchanged.
